title: UMich Campus 3D Model | Ann Arbor Campus
description: Explore the University of Michigan Ann Arbor campus and neighboring streets in 3D: Central, North, Medical and Athletic sectors, individual building layers, mapped landscape and USGS terrain. Download 3DS and layered Rhino models.
